description: Fix client-side composable and UX issues: (1) useAdminAuth composable doesn't share state across components - use useState instead of ref. (2) No error handling in admin settings save operations. (3) Password change doesn't force re-login. (4) Admin layout not responsive on mobile - needs hamburger menu.
steps: In app/composables/useAdminAuth.ts - replace ref(false) and ref(true) with useState('admin-authenticated', () => false) and useState('admin-loading', () => true). This ensures the middleware and layout share the same reactive state. Import useState from nuxt (auto-imported).

In all settings pages (hero.vue, site.vue, projects.vue, sites.vue, timeline.vue, footer.vue) - wrap the $fetch call in handleSave with try/catch. Add an 'error' ref (string). On catch, set error.value to a user-friendly message (e.g. e?.data?.message || '保存失败'). Display the error message with class 'error-msg' near the save button. Clear error on next save attempt. The password.vue already has error handling so skip it.

In app/pages/admin/settings/password.vue - after successful password change (after setting success.value), add a setTimeout that calls the logout function after 2 seconds. Import/use the logout from useAdminAuth(). This redirects the user to login with their new password.

In app/layouts/admin.vue - make the sidebar responsive for mobile: (a) Add a hamburger toggle button visible only below 768px. (b) On mobile, sidebar should be hidden by default and slide in as an overlay when toggled. (c) Add a backdrop overlay when sidebar is open on mobile. (d) Main content should take full width on mobile (margin-left: 0). Use a ref for sidebarOpen state.
acceptance_criteria: useAdminAuth uses useState so state is shared across all component instances
All settings save handlers show error messages on failure
Password change triggers logout and redirect to login after success
Admin layout sidebar collapses on mobile with hamburger toggle
verification: Run npm run build from /projects/sandbox/WinterHome and confirm no TypeScript/build errors
